title: Introducing Soundboks Rider: the world’s most portable party speaker
summary: Learn about the performance, specs, and stats for the smallest speaker we’ve ever created.
body_markdown:
When you’re buying a speaker, you’re often left with a choice:[do you want power & performance or practicality & portability?](https://soundboks.com/blogs/in-tune/soundboks-mix-why-we-created-the-most-versatile-party-speaker)


Party speakers are designed for big audiences and loud volumes, premium audio quality, and extreme durability. On the flip side, Bluetooth speakers are travel-friendly, simple to use, lightweight, and for small spaces & groups.


Other than our[Soundboks Mix](https://soundboks.com/products/soundboks-mix) , there aren’t many options that cover both. That’s where[Soundboks Rider](https://soundboks.com/products/soundboks-rider) changes things.


## Headline sound. Handheld size.


With a 118dB max volume and audio engineered specifically for social settings, Soundboks Rider sounds just like a party speaker should. While it’s easy to focus on this power, the engineering delivers superior quality than any Bluetooth speaker at any volume.


Weighing just 6.5kgs (14.3lbs) and small enough to fit in your bag or bike basket, Rider is more like portable Bluetooth speakers in size. Normally, you wouldn’t be able to carry a party speaker around with one hand either. Whether you’re using[The Strap 2.0](https://soundboks.com/products/the-strap-2-0) or not, you won’t break a sweat moving it around.


Plus, how many Bluetooth speakers have with swappable batteries and 35 hours of life? This unlocks your ability to get off the beaten path, away from power sources, and still have the means of playing music all night long.


## Soundboks Rider is a durable outdoor party speaker


We designed Soundboks Rider for adventures. From skiing in the mountains or hiking through the woods to the everyday trips to the park, every outdoor setting has its own challenges. By prioritizing durability, you’re ready for anything to happen.


Rider is our most protected speaker yet. Its IP66 rating makes it fully dust-tight and protected against powerful, high-pressure water jets. If a rain cloud breaks or a beer spills, you can guarantee your music won’t stop this waterproof portable speaker.


The steel grill and iconic shock-absorbing ball corners are built to take real hits. We know you might chuck your speaker around or knock it over when you’re in the moment. When you’re on the move, its gonna take a few bumps. It’ll take far more than that to damage this rugged Bluetooth speaker.


## Customizable sound and full EQ control


Different environments, atmospheres, and styles of music[all require different performance from your sound.](https://soundboks.com/blogs/in-tune/denmarks-festival-kings-ultimate-outdoor-party-guide-2025) For example, you wouldn’t want wall-shaking bass if you were chilling to ambient music at home. As a customizable party speaker, Soundboks Rider allows you to find the perfect performance for your situation.


It comes with three bespoke engineered sound profiles as standard: Bass+, Outdoor, and Indoor. These are optimized for the moments their names suggest. Want more bass? Use Bass+. Listening in the park? Pick Outdoor. You get the picture.


If you want even more control, customize and create your own sound profiles. Once you’re happy, save it for next time. If you’ve really nailed it, share it with your friends. All this customization is done in the[Soundboks app](https://soundboks.com/pages/app) .


## Why doesn’t Soundboks Rider have TeamUp?


Unlike[Soundboks 4](https://soundboks.com/products/soundboks-4) and[Soundboks Mix](https://soundboks.com/products/soundboks-mix) , Rider doesn’t have TeamUp: the[SKAA-powered technology](https://soundboks.com/blogs/in-tune/what-is-skaa-technology-and-how-does-it-make-your-soundboks-even-better) that wirelessly links multiple speakers. This isn’t the result of forgetting–we designed Rider to be a standalone speaker for specific situations.


Soundboks 4 and Soundboks Mix are best for planned events. Music is non-negotiable and plays a major role in the entertainment here. Before guests arrive, you’d make sure to have a proper sound system. TeamUp enables you to scale in stereo, tactically position your sound, and create dancefloors & music zones.


Rider, on the flipside, is designed for spontaneity. These situations are never going to need a full-on sound system. One speaker capable of 118dB volumes gives you the option to party in a far more unorganised and casual way.
